result.text: The cloud infrastructure architecture team must formalize the multi-region envoy edge gateway and service mesh ingress routing specification. First, inspect the envoy filter YAML in the infrastructure Kubernetes directory and verify the gateway YAML in the k8s config folder. Then, examine the virtual service YAML in the routing service to assess how external API traffic is partitioned across clusters. The current ingress gateway configuration lacks connection pooling limits, causing worker pods to starve during traffic spikes. Update the envoy filter YAML to enforce circuit breaking with a maximum of ten thousand connections and a maximum of one thousand pending requests. In the gateway YAML, verify that tls termination uses modern TLS version one point three with automated certificate rotation via cert manager. Tag the virtual service YAML to audit traffic shifting rules, ensuring canary deployments route exactly ten percent of user traffic to v2 service endpoints. Under no circumstances should ingress gateways permit plaintext HTTP traffic without redirecting immediately to https on port four hundred forty-three. The cloud security director requires external request headers to strip internal diagnostic headers, including x-envoy-internal and x-forwarded-client-cert. The site reliability engineering team mandates automated datadog alerts for envoy upstream connection failures exceeding zero point one percent over three consecutive minutes. Ingress access logs must stream to cloudwatch logs using JSON structured formatting, including client ip path status code and upstream response time. Ingress policies in gateway YAML should restrict allowed origins exclusively to company web domains and block all wildcard origin requests. The performance engineering lead confirms that p99 latency through the envoy ingress layer must remain below eight milliseconds under fifty thousand concurrent connections. Cluster config YAML in envoy should verify health checks probe backend services every five seconds with three consecutive successes for healthy status. Cross-region fallback routing must direct ingress traffic to the secondary cloud region if local cluster availability drops below eighty percent. The security compliance team requires external web application firewall rules to block common sql injection and cross-site scripting attack signatures. Ingress pods must run across three availability zones with horizontal pod autoscalers configured to scale between twenty and one hundred replicas. Network engineers must confirm envoy connection buffer limits are set to thirty-two kilobytes to prevent memory exhaustion under slowloris attacks. Disaster recovery runbooks in docs slash require manual dns failover switches between cloud providers. The enterprise audit committee demands quarterly reviews of all envoy ingress route changes with signed approval from the infrastructure principal architect. Telemetry YAML in the observability directory should verify opentelemetry tracing samplers configure head-based sampling at five percent. The identity team confirms mutual tls authentication between edge envoy gateways and core internal microservices must use spiffe id validation. Envoy certificates deployed across ingress gateways must enforce ocsp stapling with cache timeouts of one hour. Ingress access logs must record client tls cipher versions and client certificate serial numbers for audit compliance. Automated chaos engineering drills in staging must simulate sudden ingress pod terminations to verify zero five hundred two bad gateway spikes during rolling deployments. Ingress route timeouts must enforce per-try timeout of two seconds with maximum three retry attempts. Under no circumstances should ingress gateways accept self-signed client certificates without validation against internal root ca certificates.
